column1: # Live RBAC route matrix: baseline (step 0.5), today's behaviour on the untouched code.
# Columns: id, since, actor, method, path, body, expect, tags (see tests/rbac_matrix_live.sh).
# Five callers per family: owner (member_a, owns rbac-PA), other member (member_b),
# admin not acting (admin_a), admin acting as the owner (admin_a_as_member_a), anonymous.
# A project another member cannot see answers 404 (anti-enumeration); a user-scoped
# secret route answers 403. hole:<id> marks a row on a route that finding names (feature
# document section 3, NF-xx in the current-state notes): Phase 1 writes each one's new
# expectation into p1.tsv and tags it here superseded-by:p1. The answer can stay the same
# where the probe cannot see the fix (a 405 method probe, a list whose content changes).
# ---- controls: public health, sign-in, current account ----
# A passwordless account never signs in. Each run adds one failure to its per-account
# throttle and no sign-in ever clears it, so after LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 5) runs in
# 15 minutes the answer is 429 (locked out) instead of 401: both refuse and issue no session.
# the wrong password counts against member_c, whose own sign-in later in the run clears it
# /api/auth/me names the signed-in account, never the act-as target
# update: a timestamp the route refuses after its owner check, so nothing is written
# MCP token list: the admin bypass of requireUserAccess lets an admin list any account's tokens
# users list: an admin sees every account, a member only their own row
# settings: a browser always gets masked secrets, the admin bypass included; only a service key with ?internal=true unmasks
# ---- the 20 login-only routes, called by a member who owns nothing (member_c) ----
# Action routes get a request they refuse after the login check (a non-numeric session or
# job id the agent rejects with 422, a non-multipart upload, a missing path), so no session,
# job, template or MCP server list is touched. emergency-stop-all is probed with GET (405):
# its POST takes no input and cancels every user's agent run on the shared instance.
# The scanner key reads any user's settings unmasked and any project, and ingests into any
# project (F-18). PA keeps capture off, so the ingest answers 202 and stores nothing.
# mcp/test: a member tests an HTTP draft with no userId; the agent tries 127.0.0.1:9 in its own
# container and reports the refused connection. Never a stdio draft.
# ---- project delete (last: it removes the two throwaway projects) ----
